skill.name: baoyu-comic
skill.description: Create educational and biography comics from source material with selectable art styles, tones, layouts, storyboards, image prompts, and PDF export.
skill.summary: Create structured educational comics with selectable visual styles, tones, layouts, and image-generation workflows.
skill.author: JimLiu

security_audit.summary: All 160 static matches are false positives based on the cited context. They identify documentation syntax, configuration paths, local file handling, and safe template literals rather than malicious behavior; no semantic security finding was identified.

remediation.issue: The PDF merger accepts a directory and output path from command-line arguments.
remediation.suggestion: Validate that both paths remain within an intended workspace before reading images or writing the PDF. Reject unexpected extensions and symbolic-link escapes.

remediation.issue: Image generation workflows may invoke local backend wrappers and external tools.
remediation.suggestion: Keep backend selection explicit, validate executable paths, and require confirmation before invoking a newly discovered binary or script.

remediation.issue: User-provided reference images and generated prompts are copied into output directories.
remediation.suggestion: Normalize filenames, enforce an output-root boundary, and avoid copying files outside the selected project workspace.

content.value_statement: Educational topics can be difficult to explain with plain text and generic visuals. This skill turns source material into structured comic plans, image prompts, and export-ready pages.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes a topic and proposes a comic narrative with characters, scenes, and learning goals.
Creates panel-by-panel storyboards and standalone image prompts.
Supports six art styles, seven tones, seven layouts, language selection, and reference images.
Generates character sheets and page images through an available image backend.
Merges numbered comic page images into a PDF with the bundled script.
limitations: Image generation depends on the tools, credentials, and limits of the selected backend.
Generated images may contain inaccurate or unreadable text and require user review.
The skill does not independently verify factual claims in source material.
The PDF merger supports image pages and does not provide a full comic editor.

use_cases.title: Explain a technical concept
use_cases.description: Turn a complex subject such as machine learning into a visual lesson with progressive panels and concrete metaphors.

use_cases.title: Create a biography comic
use_cases.description: Transform a person's timeline into a readable story with period-aware characters, scenes, and a clear educational conclusion.

use_cases.title: Publish a short social comic
use_cases.description: Choose a compact layout and tone to produce a focused four-panel or vertical comic for a social channel.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: One-page lesson
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a single-page educational comic about [topic] for [audience]. Use a clear beginning, explanation, visual example, and takeaway. Choose a neutral tone and standard layout.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you need a simple first draft.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Biography
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [page count]-page biography comic about [person]. Cover [key events], use [art style] and [tone], and keep each page focused on one idea. End with a resolved educational takeaway.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the subject has a defined timeline.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Reference-guided series
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a multi-page comic about [topic] using these reference images: [paths]. Use [layout], [tone], and [language]. Build a character sheet, save every final prompt, and maintain consistent visual traits across pages.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when visual consistency matters across a series.

prompt_templates.title: Expert: Regenerate selected pages
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the existing storyboard and regenerate pages [numbers] for [issue]. Preserve character identity, panel sequence, aspect ratio, and learning goals. Update the affected prompt files before rendering and merge the final pages into a PDF.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for controlled revisions to an existing comic.

output_examples.input: Explain gradient descent to beginner programmers in four panels.
output: A four-panel storyboard that introduces the optimization problem, shows a path downhill, visualizes repeated updates, and ends with a concise takeaway.
A matching image prompt describing panel positions, character actions, labels, and a limited educational color palette.

faq.question: What can this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates educational comics, biography comics, tutorials, short comic strips, storyboards, image prompts, and PDF exports.

faq.question: Which visual styles are supported?
faq.answer: Supported styles include ligne-claire, manga, realistic, ink-brush, chalk, and minimalist.

faq.question: Can I provide reference images?
faq.answer: Yes. You can provide file paths and choose direct reference, style guidance, or palette guidance.

faq.question: Does it generate the images?
faq.answer: It generates images when a compatible image backend is available in the current runtime.

faq.question: Can it create a PDF?
faq.answer: Yes. The bundled merger combines numbered PNG or JPEG pages into a PDF.

faq.question: Can I regenerate selected pages?
faq.answer: Yes. Select page numbers, update their prompts, regenerate them, and rebuild the PDF.
